dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D plane from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight localized indentation on the left lateral margin at the mid-body transition point; otherwise continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median intensity across the dorsal surface with a uniform tonal distribution.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple sets of parallel, curved, light-colored linear marks visible on the mid-to-right dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Defined longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis and visible transverse skin folds at the anterior dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive parallel linear rake marks across the dorsal plane, presenting as high-reflectance tracks against the grey baseline.
